newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares lose gains on U.S. data to end flat.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares lose gains on U.S. data to end flat.

text.p: Swedish share prices ended a rollercoaster week unchanged on Friday, losing ground with other European stocks after U.S. data suggested the strong U.S. economy was starting to show a pick up in inflation.
The general market index inched up 0.04 percent to 3,158.31 after turnover of 3.28 billion crowns.
"It's difficult to draw conclusions about next week. We are standing at a fork in the road," one broker said.
Telecoms group Ericsson edged up two crowns to 361.5, counteracting a one-crown fall of fellow heavyweight drug company Astra, which ended at 142 crowns.
Volvo ended half a crown higher at 214 after coming off intra-day highs of 217.5 crowns. The company said its U.S. car sales rose 2.2 percent in July to 7,551 vehicles.
"Volvo felt strong all day but was brought down by broad negative sentiment," one broker said.
Swedish commercial bank Handelsbanken bucked the negative trend and closed eight crowns higher at 255.
